title: BR5 Run performance
description: Run time of BR5 imports and analysis runs, per step and per setting (spec M6).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() FROM br5.run_history WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND run_type IN (${run_type:singlequote})
  AND status IN (${status:singlequote})
  AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
  AND settings_from IN (${preset:singlequote})
  AND toString(multiplier) IN (${multiplier:singlequote})
  AND choice IN (${choice:singlequote})

SELECT quantileExact(0.5)(duration_s) FROM br5.run_history WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND run_type IN (${run_type:singlequote})
  AND status IN (${status:singlequote})
  AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
  AND settings_from IN (${preset:singlequote})
  AND toString(multiplier) IN (${multiplier:singlequote})
  AND choice IN (${choice:singlequote})

SELECT min(duration_s) FROM br5.run_history WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND run_type IN (${run_type:singlequote})
  AND status IN (${status:singlequote})
  AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
  AND settings_from IN (${preset:singlequote})
  AND toString(multiplier) IN (${multiplier:singlequote})
  AND choice IN (${choice:singlequote})

SELECT max(duration_s) FROM br5.run_history WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND run_type IN (${run_type:singlequote})
  AND status IN (${status:singlequote})
  AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
  AND settings_from IN (${preset:singlequote})
  AND toString(multiplier) IN (${multiplier:singlequote})
  AND choice IN (${choice:singlequote})

panels.title: Run time over time
panels.description: One point per run, one colour per settings variant (preset and engine).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time, variant, duration_s FROM br5.run_history WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND run_type IN (${run_type:singlequote})
  AND status IN (${status:singlequote})
  AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
  AND settings_from IN (${preset:singlequote})
  AND toString(multiplier) IN (${multiplier:singlequote})
  AND choice IN (${choice:singlequote}) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Median run time by ${setting}
panels.description: Keep the other filters fixed (same choice and multiplier) so only this setting differs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT value, median_s FROM (
SELECT if(settings['${setting}'] = '', '(unset)', settings['${setting}']) AS value,
       count() AS runs,
       round(quantileExact(0.5)(duration_s), 1) AS median_s,
       round(min(duration_s), 1) AS min_s,
       round(max(duration_s), 1) AS max_s
FROM br5.run_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND run_type IN (${run_type:singlequote})
  AND status IN (${status:singlequote})
  AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
  AND settings_from IN (${preset:singlequote})
  AND toString(multiplier) IN (${multiplier:singlequote})
  AND choice IN (${choice:singlequote})
GROUP BY value ORDER BY median_s)

panels.title: Runs per value of ${setting}
panels.description: Compare medians, not single runs; repeat each variant at least 3 times (config guide).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(settings['${setting}'] = '', '(unset)', settings['${setting}']) AS value,
       count() AS runs,
       round(quantileExact(0.5)(duration_s), 1) AS median_s,
       round(min(duration_s), 1) AS min_s,
       round(max(duration_s), 1) AS max_s
FROM br5.run_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND run_type IN (${run_type:singlequote})
  AND status IN (${status:singlequote})
  AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
  AND settings_from IN (${preset:singlequote})
  AND toString(multiplier) IN (${multiplier:singlequote})
  AND choice IN (${choice:singlequote})
GROUP BY value ORDER BY median_s

panels.title: Analysis steps (latest 15 runs)
panels.description: Seconds per step. 'start-up and other' is the time outside the steps: mostly creating the Spark session.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT run, read, clean, aggregate, rank, profile, recommend, write, `start-up and other`
FROM (
SELECT started_at, concat(left(toString(run_id), 8), ' · ', variant) AS run,
       step_durations['read'] / 1000 AS read,
       step_durations['clean'] / 1000 AS clean,
       step_durations['aggregate'] / 1000 AS aggregate,
       step_durations['rank'] / 1000 AS rank,
       step_durations['profile'] / 1000 AS profile,
       step_durations['recommend'] / 1000 AS recommend,
       step_durations['write'] / 1000 AS write,
       outside_steps_s AS `start-up and other`
FROM br5.run_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND status IN (${status:singlequote})
  AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
  AND settings_from IN (${preset:singlequote})
  AND toString(multiplier) IN (${multiplier:singlequote})
  AND choice IN (${choice:singlequote}) AND run_type = 'analysis'
ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 15
) ORDER BY started_at

panels.title: Import steps (latest 8 imports)
panels.description: Seconds per step. 'start-up and other' is mostly creating the Spark session.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT run, read, check, derive, write_raw, write_dims, write_fact, verify, swap, `start-up and other`
FROM (
SELECT started_at, concat(left(toString(run_id), 8), ' · ', variant) AS run,
       step_durations['read'] / 1000 AS read,
       step_durations['check'] / 1000 AS check,
       step_durations['derive'] / 1000 AS derive,
       step_durations['write_raw'] / 1000 AS write_raw,
       step_durations['write_dims'] / 1000 AS write_dims,
       step_durations['write_fact'] / 1000 AS write_fact,
       step_durations['verify'] / 1000 AS verify,
       step_durations['swap'] / 1000 AS swap,
       outside_steps_s AS `start-up and other`
FROM br5.run_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND status IN (${status:singlequote})
  AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
  AND settings_from IN (${preset:singlequote})
  AND toString(multiplier) IN (${multiplier:singlequote})
  AND choice IN (${choice:singlequote}) AND run_type = 'import'
ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 8
) ORDER BY started_at

panels.title: Spark task time per step (latest 15 Spark runs)
panels.description: Executor task time summed over tasks, per step (from Spark's REST API). It can exceed the step's wall time when tasks run in parallel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT run, read, clean, aggregate, profile FROM (
SELECT started_at, concat(left(toString(run_id), 8), ' · ', variant) AS run,
       resources['spark.run_ms@read'] / 1000 AS read,
       resources['spark.run_ms@clean'] / 1000 AS clean,
       resources['spark.run_ms@aggregate'] / 1000 AS aggregate,
       resources['spark.run_ms@profile'] / 1000 AS profile
FROM br5.run_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND run_type IN (${run_type:singlequote})
  AND status IN (${status:singlequote})
  AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
  AND settings_from IN (${preset:singlequote})
  AND toString(multiplier) IN (${multiplier:singlequote})
  AND choice IN (${choice:singlequote}) AND run_type = 'analysis' AND engine = 'spark' AND resources['spark.run_ms'] > 0
ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 15) ORDER BY started_at

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Click run_id for the app's Run History (compare two runs), spark_app_id for the run's Spark page.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time, run_type, status, choice, variant, multiplier,
       round(duration_s, 1) AS duration_s, rows_read, rows_used, rows_written, result_count AS cards,
       toString(run_id) AS run_id, spark_app_id, error
FROM br5.run_history WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND run_type IN (${run_type:singlequote})
  AND status IN (${status:singlequote})
  AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
  AND settings_from IN (${preset:singlequote})
  AND toString(multiplier) IN (${multiplier:singlequote})
  AND choice IN (${choice:singlequote})
ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Resource figures per run
panels.description: Exact figures stored with each run. Spark CPU counts JVM task threads only (not the Python workers of the parallel reader); container CPU on the Resource use dashboard includes them. Peak heap is sampled at executor heartbeats (every 10 s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time, left(toString(run_id), 8) AS run, run_type, variant, round(duration_s, 1) AS duration_s,
       round(resources['spark.cpu_ms'] / 1000, 1) AS spark_cpu_s,
       round(resources['spark.run_ms'] / 1000, 1) AS spark_task_s,
       round(resources['spark.gc_ms'] / 1000, 2) AS spark_gc_s,
       round(resources['spark.shuffle_write_bytes'] / 1048576, 1) AS shuffle_mb,
       round((resources['spark.spill_memory_bytes'] + resources['spark.spill_disk_bytes']) / 1048576, 1) AS spill_mb,
       round(resources['spark.executor_peak_heap_bytes'] / 1048576) AS executor_heap_mb,
       round(resources['spark.driver_peak_heap_bytes'] / 1048576) AS driver_heap_mb,
       resources['clickhouse.queries'] AS ch_queries,
       resources['clickhouse.read_rows'] AS ch_rows_read,
       resources['clickhouse.written_rows'] AS ch_rows_written,
       round(resources['clickhouse.cpu_ms'] / 1000, 2) AS ch_cpu_s,
       round(resources['clickhouse.peak_memory_bytes'] / 1048576) AS ch_peak_mb
FROM br5.run_history WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND run_type IN (${run_type:singlequote})
  AND status IN (${status:singlequote})
  AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
  AND settings_from IN (${preset:singlequote})
  AND toString(multiplier) IN (${multiplier:singlequote})
  AND choice IN (${choice:singlequote})
ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 200
